description: Step 1 of 2: nothing is charged. Creates a draft project from a website URL and/or a brief with your settings (goal: a preset, or custom with a one-line goal_description of the user's own goal; platform, aspect, duration, pace (calm, normal or fast; default: the goal's), tier, resolution, language, voice, music, quantity, Brand Kit), starts the free site analysis when a URL is given, and returns a quote: quote_id, credits per video and in total, balance after. Show the quote to the user; only after they approve that exact amount, call confirm_operation(quote_id). Quotes expire after 30 minutes. Language: the one you pass always wins; without it the films follow the analysed site's language (applied once the analysis is read, at the latest at confirm_operation), else the brief's, with a native voice of that language.

brand_kit_id.description: From list_brand_kits; default: the account's default kit.

brief.description: What to say: product, audience, offer, angle. Required (20+ characters) without a url.

captions.description: Burned-in subtitles of the voice-over (default off: the video already shows its key words on screen).

goal.description: sales, signups, app_installs, launch, awareness, explainer or retarget; or custom, with goal_description (the user's own goal).

goal_description.description: With goal custom (required then): the user's own goal in one line, ≤ 140 characters — what viewers should do after watching ("Book a free 15-minute call with our team"). The script, pacing and call to action are written for it.

language.description: The films' language (voice-over, on-screen text, title). Default: the analysed site's language (with a url: applied when the analysis is done, at the latest when the quote is confirmed), else the brief's, else en. A language given here always wins.

look.description: The film's look: auto (default, picked from your brand) or a style family: editorial-paper, dark-tech, playful, luxe-editorial, bold-retail, soft-gradient, brutalist-grid, organic-illustrated (get_options describes each).

pace.description: The film's pace: calm (Calm), normal (Balanced) or fast (Punchy); get_options paces describes each. Default: fast (Punchy) for every goal. Same price; a Calm or Balanced film's default music follows its pace.

platform.description: Where it runs; sets the default aspect and safe zones.

quality.description: standard (default) or studio: one rate per second each (get_options qualities).

quantity.description: Independent variants of the same brief (plan maximum in get_options).

review_storyboard.description: Pause after each storyboard for approve_storyboard (default false: confirm_operation is the only approval; each video is storyboarded, voiced and rendered in one go, and still pauses if its price would exceed the quote).

tier.description: Deprecated: use quality. t1 / t2 = standard, t3 = studio.

url.description: Website or product page to analyse (free).

visibility.description: Default: the account setting (public in the gallery unless changed).

voice_id.description: A voice id from get_options; default: one that suits the goal, a native speaker of the language where we have one.

name: create_project
title: Prepare videos (quote)
